items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: And Ted could play. ... I'm going to have Ted put that out.

ctx.x: So they played about five minutes on it and put it away. And with me I started -- Red was on concert in Europe. And, you know, I should have played those things then, maybe we'd have all made it. "He said, 'That's you...'" I says, I haven't made it." He says, "Well, (inaudible) But I my band -- I'm out here with my band because of you. (inaudible) don't know what he meant by that. George Wein was booking everything. MR. : Well, that was a very, very musical band.

Yeah, sure could. There are a couple of sort of highlights that -- there's a period in your life where I thought you were composing some extraordinary music. And I think that the band you took to Monterey the first time, and the music you wrote for Monterey the second year, I think that was just some absolutely fantastic music.
